blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.text: Abstract

blocks.en: Safety and Security explains how ReLEAF protects the people using the system, contains engineered Bacillus subtilis, and monitors the bioreactor for signs of failure.
blocks.text: Safety and Security explains how ReLEAF protects the people using the system, contains engineered Bacillus subtilis, and monitors the bioreactor for signs of failure.
blocks.zh: 本頁說明 ReLEAF 如何保護使用系統的人、如何圍阻工程化的 Bacillus subtilis，以及如何監看生物反應器是否出現failure的徵兆。

blocks.en: Every team member completes biosafety training before beginning experimental work, and all wet-lab work is conducted at BSL-1 using a non-pathogenic Bacillus subtilis chassis. In the bioreactor, a 0.2 µm hollow-fiber membrane separates the bacterial culture from the product stream while retaining whole cells. After 24 hours of testing, no colonies were observed from the shell-side sample. The system also incorporates pressure monitoring and external leak detection as additional layers of containment and operational safety.
blocks.text: Every team member completes biosafety training before beginning experimental work, and all wet-lab work is conducted at BSL-1 using a non-pathogenic Bacillus subtilis chassis. In the bioreactor, a 0.2 µm hollow-fiber membrane separates the bacterial culture from the product stream while retaining whole cells. After 24 hours of testing, no colonies were observed from the shell-side sample. The system also incorporates pressure monitoring and external leak detection as additional layers of containment and operational safety.
blocks.zh: 每位團隊成員在開始實驗工作之前都須完成生物安全訓練，所有濕實驗工作都在 BSL-1 等級下、以非病原性的 Bacillus subtilis 作為宿主進行。在生物反應器中，一張 0.2 µm 的中空纖維膜把菌液與產物流分開，同時把完整細胞留下。測試 24 小時後，殼側樣品未觀察到任何菌落。系統另有壓力監測與外部漏液偵測，作為圍阻與運轉安全的額外層次。

blocks.en: Biosafety
blocks.text: Biosafety
blocks.zh: 生物安全

blocks.en: Biosafety and biosecurity are essential principles that ensure responsible conduct in biological research and experiments. Biosafety focuses on protecting people, the environment and the community from unintentional exposure to biological agents and hazardous materials, while biosecurity emphasizes preventing misuse, unauthorized access or unintentional release of resources. Together, they form the foundations of safe laboratory practice.
blocks.text: Biosafety and biosecurity are essential principles that ensure responsible conduct in biological research and experiments. Biosafety focuses on protecting people, the environment and the community from unintentional exposure to biological agents and hazardous materials, while biosecurity emphasizes preventing misuse, unauthorized access or unintentional release of resources. Together, they form the foundations of safe laboratory practice.
blocks.zh: 生物安全（biosafety）與生物防護（biosecurity）是確保生物研究與實驗負責任進行的根本原則。生物安全著重保護人、環境與社區，避免非預期地暴露於生物材料與危害物質；生物防護則著重防止濫用、未經授權的取用，或資源的非預期釋出。兩者合起來構成安全實驗室操作的基礎。

blocks.en: Training
blocks.text: Training
blocks.zh: 訓練

blocks.en: Biosafety training
blocks.text: Biosafety training
blocks.zh: 生物安全訓練

blocks.en: Biosafety training is mandatory at GEMS Taiwan. It includes formal instruction in laboratory safety principles, completion of a written examination and signing of a consent form confirming understanding and compliance with regulations. High performance in safety assessments is expected, demonstrating strong understanding of responsibility, therefore it requires retesting until full score.
blocks.text: Biosafety training is mandatory at GEMS Taiwan. It includes formal instruction in laboratory safety principles, completion of a written examination and signing of a consent form confirming understanding and compliance with regulations. High performance in safety assessments is expected, demonstrating strong understanding of responsibility, therefore it requires retesting until full score.
blocks.zh: 生物安全訓練在 GEMS Taiwan 是強制的。內容包括實驗室安全原則的正式授課、完成筆試，以及簽署同意書，確認理解並遵守相關規定。安全評量要求高標準表現，以展現對責任的充分理解，因此必須重考到滿分為止。

blocks.en: Basic laboratory training
blocks.text: Basic laboratory training
blocks.zh: 基礎實驗訓練

blocks.en: A structured two month basic laboratory training program provides hands-on experience in essential molecular biology techniques including miniprep, restriction enzyme digestion, Golden Gate assembly, gel electrophoresis, PCR, bacterial transformation, and liquid culture handling. This training ensures technical competence of everyone who enters the lab while reinforcing safe laboratory habits.
blocks.text: A structured two month basic laboratory training program provides hands-on experience in essential molecular biology techniques including miniprep, restriction enzyme digestion, Golden Gate assembly, gel electrophoresis, PCR, bacterial transformation, and liquid culture handling. This training ensures technical competence of everyone who enters the lab while reinforcing safe laboratory habits.
blocks.zh: 為期兩個月、結構化的基礎實驗訓練提供必要分子生物學技術的實作經驗，包括質體小量製備、限制酶切割、Golden Gate 組裝、凝膠電泳、PCR、細菌轉形與液體培養的操作。這套訓練確保每一位進入實驗室的人都具備技術能力，同時強化安全的實驗習慣。

blocks.en: All personnel must achieve a full score on the biosafety examination to demonstrate strong understanding of safety protocol and responsibilities. Retesting is required until a perfect score is achieved. Clear roles and responsibilities are established for all team members, ensuring accountability and understanding of individual obligations in maintaining laboratory safety standards.
blocks.text: All personnel must achieve a full score on the biosafety examination to demonstrate strong understanding of safety protocol and responsibilities. Retesting is required until a perfect score is achieved. Clear roles and responsibilities are established for all team members, ensuring accountability and understanding of individual obligations in maintaining laboratory safety standards.
blocks.zh: 所有人員都必須在生物安全考試中取得滿分，以證明充分理解安全規範與責任；未達滿分即須重考。團隊成員的角色與職責都有明確界定，確保責任歸屬，也確保每個人都清楚自己在維持實驗室安全標準上的義務。

blocks.en: Research framework and biological systems
blocks.text: Research framework and biological systems
blocks.zh: 研究架構與生物系統

blocks.en: Safe research relies on using peer-reviewed scientific literature, such as PubMed, to guide experimental design and ensure biosafety. These studies provide validated methods, risk assessments, and established safety principles that help researchers choose appropriate organisms, tools, and containment strategies. In synthetic biology and microbiology, this evidence-based approach ensures experiments follow proven safety standards while incorporating up-to-date knowledge from the scientific community.
blocks.text: Safe research relies on using peer-reviewed scientific literature, such as PubMed, to guide experimental design and ensure biosafety. These studies provide validated methods, risk assessments, and established safety principles that help researchers choose appropriate organisms, tools, and containment strategies. In synthetic biology and microbiology, this evidence-based approach ensures experiments follow proven safety standards while incorporating up-to-date knowledge from the scientific community.
blocks.zh: 安全的研究仰賴同儕審查的科學文獻（例如 PubMed）來引導實驗設計、確保生物安全。這些研究提供經驗證的方法、風險評估與既有的安全原則，幫助研究者選擇合適的生物、工具與圍阻策略。在合成生物學與微生物學中，這種以證據為本的做法，確保實驗遵循已被證實的安全標準，同時納入科學社群的最新知識。

blocks.en: Experiments are therefore conducted using non-pathogenic chassis organisms such as Bacillus subtilis, ensuring a safe and well-characterized biological platform. Standard genetic elements and antibiotic resistance markers are used under strict biosafety guidelines. All experiments are designed and performed within controlled conditions to maintain safety and reliability.
blocks.text: Experiments are therefore conducted using non-pathogenic chassis organisms such as Bacillus subtilis, ensuring a safe and well-characterized biological platform. Standard genetic elements and antibiotic resistance markers are used under strict biosafety guidelines. All experiments are designed and performed within controlled conditions to maintain safety and reliability.
blocks.zh: 因此，實驗都使用 Bacillus subtilis 這類非病原性的宿主生物，提供安全且特性清楚的生物平台。標準的基因元件與抗生素抗性標記都在嚴格的生物安全規範下使用。所有實驗都在受控條件下設計與執行，以維持安全與可靠。

blocks.en: Primary containment: hollow fiber membrane
blocks.text: Primary containment: hollow fiber membrane
blocks.zh: 初級圍阻：中空纖維膜

blocks.en: The hollow fiber membrane is the critical containment barrier that prevents bacterial cells and culture medium from escaping the bioreactor system. This semi-permeable membrane serves as the primary physical barrier between the bioreactor culture and the external environment:
blocks.text: The hollow fiber membrane is the critical containment barrier that prevents bacterial cells and culture medium from escaping the bioreactor system. This semi-permeable membrane serves as the primary physical barrier between the bioreactor culture and the external environment:
blocks.zh: 中空纖維膜是關鍵的圍阻屏障，防止細菌細胞與培養液逸出生物反應器系統。這張半透膜是反應器菌液與外界環境之間的主要實體屏障：

blocks.en: The hollow fiber membrane has precise pore size specifications (0.2 μm nominal pore size) that allow nutrient and waste exchange while retaining bacterial cells
blocks.text: The hollow fiber membrane has precise pore size specifications (0.2 μm nominal pore size) that allow nutrient and waste exchange while retaining bacterial cells
blocks.zh: 中空纖維膜有精確的孔徑規格（標稱孔徑 0.2 μm），可讓養分與廢物交換，同時把細菌細胞留下

blocks.en: The membrane's design prevents the passage of bacterial cells (0.25 to 1.0 μm in diameter) while permitting controlled diffusion of small molecules (nutrients, oxygen, waste products)
blocks.text: The membrane's design prevents the passage of bacterial cells (0.25 to 1.0 μm in diameter) while permitting controlled diffusion of small molecules (nutrients, oxygen, waste products)
blocks.zh: 膜的設計阻擋細菌細胞（直徑 0.25 至 1.0 μm）通過，同時允許小分子（養分、氧氣、代謝廢物）受控擴散

blocks.en: The large surface area of the hollow fiber membrane system allows efficient exchange of nutrients and removal of metabolic waste while maintaining strict containment
blocks.text: The large surface area of the hollow fiber membrane system allows efficient exchange of nutrients and removal of metabolic waste while maintaining strict containment
blocks.zh: 中空纖維膜系統的大表面積讓養分交換與代謝廢物移除都很有效率，同時維持嚴格的圍阻

blocks.en: Regular inspection and integrity testing of the membrane are essential to ensure it remains the effective primary containment barrier
blocks.text: Regular inspection and integrity testing of the membrane are essential to ensure it remains the effective primary containment barrier
blocks.zh: 定期檢查與完整性測試是必要的，以確保膜持續作為有效的初級圍阻屏障

blocks.en: Any signs of membrane degradation, discoloration, or suspected compromise must be reported immediately and the system taken offline for investigation and replacement if necessary
blocks.text: Any signs of membrane degradation, discoloration, or suspected compromise must be reported immediately and the system taken offline for investigation and replacement if necessary
blocks.zh: 任何膜劣化、變色或疑似受損的跡象都必須立即通報，並讓系統離線檢查，必要時更換

blocks.en: Cell retention and sterility assessment of the shell-side permeate. (a) Lumen-side medium was sampled after running for 24 hours in the bioreactor, demonstrating the appearance of some colonies. (b) Shell-side medium sampled after running for 24 hours in the bioreactor, with no colony grown.
blocks.text: Cell retention and sterility assessment of the shell-side permeate. (a) Lumen-side medium was sampled after running for 24 hours in the bioreactor, demonstrating the appearance of some colonies. (b) Shell-side medium sampled after running for 24 hours in the bioreactor, with no colony grown.
blocks.zh: 殼側透過液的細胞留存與無菌評估。(a) 在生物反應器運轉 24 小時後取樣的管腔側培養液，可見部分菌落。(b) 在生物反應器運轉 24 小時後取樣的殼側培養液，未長出任何菌落。

blocks.en: Secondary containment: physical containment and leak detection
blocks.text: Secondary containment: physical containment and leak detection
blocks.zh: 次級圍阻：實體圍阻與漏液偵測

blocks.en: The bioreactor system is designed with containment features and multiple detection mechanisms:
blocks.text: The bioreactor system is designed with containment features and multiple detection mechanisms:
blocks.zh: 生物反應器系統的設計具備圍阻特性與多重偵測機制：

blocks.en: TMP (transmembrane pressure) leakage detection
blocks.text: TMP (transmembrane pressure) leakage detection
blocks.zh: TMP（跨膜壓差）洩漏偵測

blocks.en: Real-time monitoring of transmembrane pressure ensures early detection of membrane integrity failure
blocks.text: Real-time monitoring of transmembrane pressure ensures early detection of membrane integrity failure
blocks.zh: 即時監測跨膜壓差，確保能及早發現膜完整性失效

blocks.en: Abnormal pressure changes indicate potential breaches in the containment system
blocks.text: Abnormal pressure changes indicate potential breaches in the containment system
blocks.zh: 異常的壓力變化顯示圍阻系統可能有破口

blocks.en: Automated alerts trigger containment protocols if TMP exceeds safe thresholds
blocks.text: Automated alerts trigger containment protocols if TMP exceeds safe thresholds
blocks.zh: 若 TMP 超過安全門檻，自動警示會啟動圍阻程序

blocks.en: Droplet leakage detection
blocks.text: Droplet leakage detection
blocks.zh: 液滴洩漏偵測

blocks.en: Sensor systems monitor for liquid leakage from the bioreactor vessel and associated tubing
blocks.text: Sensor systems monitor for liquid leakage from the bioreactor vessel and associated tubing
blocks.zh: 感測系統監看生物反應器槽體與相關管路是否有液體洩漏

blocks.en: Early detection of even small droplet leaks prevents environmental release of biological material
blocks.text: Early detection of even small droplet leaks prevents environmental release of biological material
blocks.zh: 及早偵測到即使很小的液滴洩漏，也能防止生物材料釋出到環境中

blocks.en: Detection triggers immediate containment and decontamination procedures
blocks.text: Detection triggers immediate containment and decontamination procedures
blocks.zh: 一旦偵測到，立即啟動圍阻與除污程序

blocks.en: Shell side turbulent detection
blocks.text: Shell side turbulent detection
blocks.zh: 殼側擾流偵測

blocks.en: Monitoring of shell-side fluid dynamics ensures optimal containment conditions
blocks.text: Monitoring of shell-side fluid dynamics ensures optimal containment conditions
blocks.zh: 監看殼側的流體動態，確保圍阻條件維持在最佳狀態

blocks.en: Changes in flow patterns can indicate equipment failure or breaches
blocks.text: Changes in flow patterns can indicate equipment failure or breaches
blocks.zh: 流型的改變可能代表設備故障或出現破口

blocks.en: Continuous monitoring maintains system integrity throughout operation
blocks.text: Continuous monitoring maintains system integrity throughout operation
blocks.zh: 持續監看讓系統在整段運轉中維持完整

blocks.text: Our bioreactor project has been evaluated for potential dual-use research of concern (DURC) implications. DURC refers to legitimate research that could potentially be misused to pose a biological threat.

blocks.text: Access to the bioreactor system, engineered strains, and operational protocols is restricted to authorized laboratory personnel

blocks.en: Lab coats and protective gowns hanging on a drying rack after use.
blocks.text: Lab coats and protective gowns hanging on a drying rack after use.
blocks.zh: 使用後掛在晾架上的實驗衣與防護袍。

blocks.en: Second biosafety cabinet with blue frame and transparent safety glass, used for sterile work and hazardous material containment.
blocks.text: Second biosafety cabinet with blue frame and transparent safety glass, used for sterile work and hazardous material containment.
blocks.zh: 第二座生物安全櫃，藍色框架與透明安全玻璃，用於無菌操作與危害物質圍阻。

blocks.en: Emergency eyewash station with yellow pull-down activator lever and solution container for rinsing eye contamination.
blocks.text: Emergency eyewash station with yellow pull-down activator lever and solution container for rinsing eye contamination.
blocks.zh: 緊急洗眼器，附黃色下拉啟動桿與沖洗眼睛用的溶液容器。

blocks.en: Brady SPC universal spill kit in yellow storage bag, ready for emergency response to chemical or liquid spills.
blocks.text: Brady SPC universal spill kit in yellow storage bag, ready for emergency response to chemical or liquid spills.
blocks.zh: 裝在黃色收納袋中的 Brady SPC 通用洩漏處理包，可隨時應付化學品或液體洩漏。

blocks.en: First aid box alongside a fire extinguisher and reference materials for medical emergencies.
blocks.text: First aid box alongside a fire extinguisher and reference materials for medical emergencies.
blocks.zh: 急救箱，旁邊是滅火器與醫療急救的參考資料。

blocks.en: All personnel must be familiar with the location and proper use of these facilities.
blocks.text: All personnel must be familiar with the location and proper use of these facilities.
blocks.zh: 所有人員都必須熟悉這些設施的位置與正確用法。

blocks.zh: 風險評估

blocks.text: Chemical

blocks.text: Physical
blocks.zh: 物理

blocks.en: Chemical hazards
blocks.text: Chemical hazards
blocks.zh: 化學危害

blocks.en: Chemical hazards are identified and managed through proper risk assessment procedures. All laboratory personnel are trained to consult Safety Data Sheets (SDS) to understand the properties, hazards, handling requirements, and emergency measures associated with chemicals. Proper storage practices are followed to prevent incompatible substances from coming into contact and to minimize the risk of accidents. To reduce exposure to chemical hazards, a strict laboratory dress code is enforced. Personnel must wear gloves, lab coats, long pants and closed-toe shoes, while shorts and open footwear such as slippers are prohibited. Long hair must be tied back to prevent accidental contact with chemicals or laboratory equipment.
blocks.text: Chemical hazards are identified and managed through proper risk assessment procedures. All laboratory personnel are trained to consult Safety Data Sheets (SDS) to understand the properties, hazards, handling requirements, and emergency measures associated with chemicals. Proper storage practices are followed to prevent incompatible substances from coming into contact and to minimize the risk of accidents. To reduce exposure to chemical hazards, a strict laboratory dress code is enforced. Personnel must wear gloves, lab coats, long pants and closed-toe shoes, while shorts and open footwear such as slippers are prohibited. Long hair must be tied back to prevent accidental contact with chemicals or laboratory equipment.
blocks.zh: 化學危害透過適當的風險評估程序辨識與管理。所有實驗室人員都受過訓練，會查閱安全資料表（SDS），以了解化學品的性質、危害、處理要求與緊急措施。儲存上遵循正確做法，避免不相容物質接觸，把意外風險降到最低。為降低化學危害的暴露，實驗室執行嚴格的服裝規定：人員必須戴手套、穿實驗衣、長褲與包覆式鞋，禁止短褲與拖鞋這類露趾鞋。長髮必須綁起，以免意外接觸化學品或實驗器材。

blocks.en: Physical hazards
blocks.text: Physical hazards
blocks.zh: 物理危害

blocks.en: Physical hazards, including thermal risks, machinery, glass apparatus, high-pressure vessels, and physical injuries, are managed by adhering to posted laboratory rules and GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard pictograms as well as receiving proper equipment training before operating any machinery or specialized apparatus. Fire risks are controlled through readily available fire blankets and fire extinguishers, and minor injuries with a stocked first aid box. Furthermore, all risks were addressed during laboratory safety training.
blocks.text: Physical hazards, including thermal risks, machinery, glass apparatus, high-pressure vessels, and physical injuries, are managed by adhering to posted laboratory rules and GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard pictograms as well as receiving proper equipment training before operating any machinery or specialized apparatus. Fire risks are controlled through readily available fire blankets and fire extinguishers, and minor injuries with a stocked first aid box. Furthermore, all risks were addressed during laboratory safety training.
blocks.zh: 物理危害包括高溫風險、機械、玻璃器皿、高壓容器與人身傷害，管理方式是遵守張貼的實驗室規則與 GHS（全球調和制度）危害圖示，並在操作任何機械或特殊儀器之前接受適當的設備訓練。火災風險以隨手可取的防火毯與滅火器控制，輕微傷害則以備品齊全的急救箱處理。此外，所有風險都在實驗室安全訓練中說明過。

blocks.en: Laboratory safety signage displaying rules, hazard classifications (biological hazard, toxic/poison materials, P1 laboratory), required personal protective equipment (lab coat, gloves, pants, closed-toe shoes), and GHS hazard pictograms.
blocks.text: Laboratory safety signage displaying rules, hazard classifications (biological hazard, toxic/poison materials, P1 laboratory), required personal protective equipment (lab coat, gloves, pants, closed-toe shoes), and GHS hazard pictograms.
blocks.zh: 實驗室安全標示，顯示規則、危害分類（生物危害、毒性物質、P1 實驗室）、必要的個人防護裝備（實驗衣、手套、長褲、包覆式鞋）與 GHS 危害圖示。

blocks.en: BKMAMLAB latex examination glove boxes in various sizes (XS, S) with premium extreme protection packaging.
blocks.text: BKMAMLAB latex examination glove boxes in various sizes (XS, S) with premium extreme protection packaging.
blocks.zh: BKMAMLAB 各種尺寸（XS、S）的乳膠檢驗手套盒，包裝標示高強度防護。

blocks.en: Spill risk assessment
blocks.text: Spill risk assessment
blocks.zh: 洩漏風險評估

blocks.en: Accidental spills can pose biological and chemical hazards if not handled correctly. Laboratory members are trained in spill response procedures to ensure safe containment, cleanup, and disposal of spilled materials. When handling biological samples, biosafety cabinets are used to provide containment and reduce the risk of exposure or environmental release. Additionally, volatile or reactive procedures are conducted inside a chemical hood. If a liquid release occurs, a spill kit containing absorbent materials, neutralizing agents, and specialized PPE is available for use to contain and clean up the spill safely.
blocks.text: Accidental spills can pose biological and chemical hazards if not handled correctly. Laboratory members are trained in spill response procedures to ensure safe containment, cleanup, and disposal of spilled materials. When handling biological samples, biosafety cabinets are used to provide containment and reduce the risk of exposure or environmental release. Additionally, volatile or reactive procedures are conducted inside a chemical hood. If a liquid release occurs, a spill kit containing absorbent materials, neutralizing agents, and specialized PPE is available for use to contain and clean up the spill safely.
blocks.zh: 意外洩漏若未正確處理，可能造成生物與化學危害。實驗室成員都受過洩漏應變訓練，以確保安全地圍堵、清理與處置洩漏物。處理生物樣品時使用生物安全櫃提供圍阻，降低暴露或釋出到環境的風險。此外，揮發性或具反應性的操作都在化學排煙櫃內進行。若發生液體外洩，可使用內含吸附材料、中和劑與專用 PPE 的洩漏處理包，安全地圍堵並清理。

blocks.en: Biological waste management
blocks.text: Biological waste management
blocks.zh: 生物廢棄物管理

blocks.en: Proper waste management is critical to preventing environmental release and protecting personnel. Biological waste disposal follows strict protocols.
blocks.text: Proper waste management is critical to preventing environmental release and protecting personnel. Biological waste disposal follows strict protocols.
blocks.zh: 妥善的廢棄物管理對防止釋出到環境、保護人員至關重要。生物廢棄物的處置遵循嚴格的規範。

blocks.en: Solid biological waste (culture plates, contaminated materials) is autoclaved at 121 °C for 15 to 30 minutes before disposal.
blocks.text: Solid biological waste (culture plates, contaminated materials) is autoclaved at 121 °C for 15 to 30 minutes before disposal.
blocks.zh: 固態生物廢棄物（培養盤、受污染材料）在處置前以 121 °C 高壓滅菌 15 至 30 分鐘。

blocks.en: Liquid biological waste is treated with appropriate disinfectants (10% bleach or equivalent) before safe disposal
blocks.text: Liquid biological waste is treated with appropriate disinfectants (10% bleach or equivalent) before safe disposal
blocks.zh: 液態生物廢棄物在安全處置前以適當消毒劑（10% 漂白水或同等品）處理

blocks.en: All waste disposal conforms to BSL-1 (Biosafety Level 1) standards to ensure the safety of laboratory personnel and the environment
blocks.text: All waste disposal conforms to BSL-1 (Biosafety Level 1) standards to ensure the safety of laboratory personnel and the environment
blocks.zh: 所有廢棄物處置皆符合 BSL-1（生物安全第一等級）標準，以確保實驗室人員與環境的安全

blocks.en: Autoclave (pressure sterilizer) with stainless steel chamber and control panel for sterilizing equipment and materials.
blocks.text: Autoclave (pressure sterilizer) with stainless steel chamber and control panel for sterilizing equipment and materials.
blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌器，具不鏽鋼腔體與控制面板，用於器材與材料的滅菌。

blocks.en: Emergency procedures
blocks.text: Emergency procedures
blocks.zh: 緊急程序

blocks.en: All laboratory personnel are trained in emergency response protocols to ensure rapid and appropriate actions in case of incidents. Clear procedures are established for the following emergency scenarios:
blocks.text: All laboratory personnel are trained in emergency response protocols to ensure rapid and appropriate actions in case of incidents. Clear procedures are established for the following emergency scenarios:
blocks.zh: 所有實驗室人員都接受過緊急應變訓練，以確保事故發生時能迅速、適當地處置。以下情境都已訂有明確程序：

blocks.en: Chemical spillage
blocks.text: Chemical spillage
blocks.zh: 化學品洩漏

blocks.en: Response protocol:
blocks.text: Response protocol:
blocks.zh: 應變程序：

blocks.en: Immediately alert nearby personnel and evacuate the affected area if the spill is large or involves hazardous substances
blocks.text: Immediately alert nearby personnel and evacuate the affected area if the spill is large or involves hazardous substances
blocks.zh: 立即通知附近人員；若洩漏量大或涉及危害物質，疏散受影響區域

blocks.en: Consult the SDS of the spilled chemical to understand appropriate response measures
blocks.text: Consult the SDS of the spilled chemical to understand appropriate response measures
blocks.zh: 查閱該化學品的 SDS，了解適當的應變措施

blocks.en: Put on appropriate PPE (gloves, lab coat, eye protection)
blocks.text: Put on appropriate PPE (gloves, lab coat, eye protection)
blocks.zh: 穿戴適當的 PPE（手套、實驗衣、護目裝備）

blocks.en: Use absorbent materials from the spill kit to contain the spill
blocks.text: Use absorbent materials from the spill kit to contain the spill
blocks.zh: 使用洩漏處理包中的吸附材料把洩漏圍堵起來

blocks.en: For reactive or volatile chemicals, use a chemical hood or well-ventilated area
blocks.text: For reactive or volatile chemicals, use a chemical hood or well-ventilated area
blocks.zh: 若是反應性或揮發性化學品，在化學排煙櫃或通風良好處作業

blocks.en: Use neutralizing agents if applicable (e.g., sodium bicarbonate for acids)
blocks.text: Use neutralizing agents if applicable (e.g., sodium bicarbonate for acids)
blocks.zh: 必要時使用中和劑（例如以碳酸氫鈉中和酸）

blocks.en: Dispose of contaminated materials in appropriate hazardous waste containers
blocks.text: Dispose of contaminated materials in appropriate hazardous waste containers
blocks.zh: 把受污染的材料放進適當的危害廢棄物容器

blocks.en: Decontaminate the work surface with appropriate disinfectant
blocks.text: Decontaminate the work surface with appropriate disinfectant
blocks.zh: 以適當消毒劑對作業檯面除污

blocks.en: Report the incident to the laboratory supervisor and document the event
blocks.text: Report the incident to the laboratory supervisor and document the event
blocks.zh: 向實驗室負責人通報，並記錄事件

blocks.en: Biohazard spillage
blocks.text: Biohazard spillage
blocks.zh: 生物危害洩漏

blocks.en: Response protocol:
blocks.text: Response protocol:
blocks.zh: 應變程序：

blocks.en: Immediately alert nearby personnel and evacuate the affected area
blocks.text: Immediately alert nearby personnel and evacuate the affected area
blocks.zh: 立即通知附近人員並疏散受影響區域

blocks.en: Do not touch or attempt to clean the spill without proper PPE
blocks.text: Do not touch or attempt to clean the spill without proper PPE
blocks.zh: 未穿戴適當 PPE 前，不要碰觸或嘗試清理洩漏物

blocks.en: Put on appropriate PPE (gloves, eye protection, lab coat, and potentially a mask)
blocks.text: Put on appropriate PPE (gloves, eye protection, lab coat, and potentially a mask)
blocks.zh: 穿戴適當的 PPE（手套、護目裝備、實驗衣，必要時加口罩）

blocks.en: Notify the biosafety officer or laboratory supervisor immediately
blocks.text: Notify the biosafety officer or laboratory supervisor immediately
blocks.zh: 立即通知生物安全負責人或實驗室負責人

blocks.en: If the spill occurred outside a biosafety cabinet, carefully move the spill kit to the affected area
blocks.text: If the spill occurred outside a biosafety cabinet, carefully move the spill kit to the affected area
blocks.zh: 若洩漏發生在生物安全櫃外，小心把洩漏處理包移到受影響區域

blocks.en: Cover the spill with absorbent material (e.g., paper towels)
blocks.text: Cover the spill with absorbent material (e.g., paper towels)
blocks.zh: 以吸附材料（例如紙巾）覆蓋洩漏物

blocks.en: Spray with disinfectant (10% bleach or equivalent) and allow contact time (typically 10 to 15 minutes)
blocks.text: Spray with disinfectant (10% bleach or equivalent) and allow contact time (typically 10 to 15 minutes)
blocks.zh: 噴上消毒劑（10% 漂白水或同等品），並留足接觸時間（通常 10 至 15 分鐘）

blocks.en: Carefully collect contaminated materials and place in biohazard waste containers
blocks.text: Carefully collect contaminated materials and place in biohazard waste containers
blocks.zh: 小心收集受污染材料，放入生物危害廢棄物容器

blocks.en: Clean and disinfect the affected area thoroughly
blocks.text: Clean and disinfect the affected area thoroughly
blocks.zh: 徹底清潔並消毒受影響區域

blocks.en: Document the incident and review circumstances to prevent recurrence
blocks.text: Document the incident and review circumstances to prevent recurrence
blocks.zh: 記錄事件，並檢討前後情形以防再次發生

blocks.en: Fire
blocks.text: Fire
blocks.zh: 火災

blocks.en: Response protocol:
blocks.text: Response protocol:
blocks.zh: 應變程序：

blocks.en: Evacuate the laboratory immediately if the fire is large or spreading
blocks.text: Evacuate the laboratory immediately if the fire is large or spreading
blocks.zh: 若火勢大或正在蔓延，立即疏散實驗室

blocks.en: Alert other personnel by activating the fire alarm
blocks.text: Alert other personnel by activating the fire alarm
blocks.zh: 啟動火警警報，通知其他人員

blocks.en: Use a fire extinguisher only if the fire is small and contained and you have a clear escape route
blocks.text: Use a fire extinguisher only if the fire is small and contained and you have a clear escape route
blocks.zh: 只有在火勢小且受控、且你有明確逃生路線時，才使用滅火器

blocks.en: Aim the extinguisher at the base of the flames using a sweeping motion
blocks.text: Aim the extinguisher at the base of the flames using a sweeping motion
blocks.zh: 以橫掃方式把滅火器對準火焰底部

blocks.en: If the fire continues to spread or smoke becomes heavy, evacuate immediately
blocks.text: If the fire continues to spread or smoke becomes heavy, evacuate immediately
blocks.zh: 若火勢持續蔓延或濃煙變大，立即撤離

blocks.en: Close doors behind you to slow the spread of fire and smoke
blocks.text: Close doors behind you to slow the spread of fire and smoke
blocks.zh: 離開時隨手關門，減緩火勢與濃煙擴散

blocks.en: Move to the designated assembly point outside the building
blocks.text: Move to the designated assembly point outside the building
blocks.zh: 移動到建築物外指定的集合點

blocks.en: Do not attempt to re-enter the laboratory under any circumstances
blocks.text: Do not attempt to re-enter the laboratory under any circumstances
blocks.zh: 在任何情況下都不要嘗試返回實驗室

blocks.en: Wait for the fire department to arrive and provide them with information about any hazardous chemicals in the lab
blocks.text: Wait for the fire department to arrive and provide them with information about any hazardous chemicals in the lab
blocks.zh: 等待消防單位到場，並向他們說明實驗室內的危害化學品

blocks.en: Chemical exposure
blocks.text: Chemical exposure
blocks.zh: 化學品暴露

blocks.en: Response protocol:
blocks.text: Response protocol:
blocks.zh: 應變程序：

blocks.en: Skin exposure: Immediately remove contaminated clothing and flush the affected area with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes. Seek medical attention if irritation persists.
blocks.text: Skin exposure: Immediately remove contaminated clothing and flush the affected area with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes. Seek medical attention if irritation persists.
blocks.zh: 皮膚暴露：立即脫除受污染衣物，以大量清水沖洗患部至少 15 分鐘。若刺激持續，就醫。

blocks.en: Eye exposure: Use the eyewash station to flush eyes thoroughly for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. Seek immediate medical attention.
blocks.text: Eye exposure: Use the eyewash station to flush eyes thoroughly for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. Seek immediate medical attention.
blocks.zh: 眼睛暴露：使用洗眼器徹底沖洗眼睛至少 15 分鐘，並撐開眼瞼。立即就醫。

blocks.en: Inhalation exposure: Move to fresh air immediately. If breathing is difficult, seek immediate medical attention and provide responders with information about the chemical involved.
blocks.text: Inhalation exposure: Move to fresh air immediately. If breathing is difficult, seek immediate medical attention and provide responders with information about the chemical involved.
blocks.zh: 吸入暴露：立即移到新鮮空氣處。若呼吸困難，立即就醫，並向救護人員說明涉及的化學品。

blocks.en: Ingestion exposure: Do not induce vomiting. Seek immediate medical attention and bring the SDS of the ingested chemical.
blocks.text: Ingestion exposure: Do not induce vomiting. Seek immediate medical attention and bring the SDS of the ingested chemical.
blocks.zh: 食入暴露：不要催吐。立即就醫，並攜帶該化學品的 SDS。

blocks.en: Notify the laboratory supervisor and document the incident
blocks.text: Notify the laboratory supervisor and document the incident
blocks.zh: 通知實驗室負責人，並記錄事件

blocks.en: Follow up with appropriate medical care as needed
blocks.text: Follow up with appropriate medical care as needed
blocks.zh: 視需要安排後續醫療照護

blocks.en: Injury
blocks.text: Injury
blocks.zh: 受傷

blocks.en: Response protocol:
blocks.text: Response protocol:
blocks.zh: 應變程序：

blocks.en: Minor injuries (cuts, abrasions, minor burns):
blocks.text: Minor injuries (cuts, abrasions, minor burns):
blocks.zh: 輕微傷害（割傷、擦傷、輕度燒燙傷）：

blocks.en: Stop work and move to a safe location
blocks.text: Stop work and move to a safe location
blocks.zh: 停止手邊工作，移到安全位置

blocks.en: Wash the wound with soap and water
blocks.text: Wash the wound with soap and water
blocks.zh: 以肥皂與清水清洗傷口

blocks.en: Apply appropriate first aid using materials from the first aid kit
blocks.text: Apply appropriate first aid using materials from the first aid kit
blocks.zh: 使用急救箱的物品做適當的急救處理

blocks.en: Apply pressure if bleeding to control hemorrhage
blocks.text: Apply pressure if bleeding to control hemorrhage
blocks.zh: 若有出血，加壓止血

blocks.en: Cover the wound with sterile gauze or a bandage
blocks.text: Cover the wound with sterile gauze or a bandage
blocks.zh: 以無菌紗布或繃帶覆蓋傷口

blocks.en: Notify the laboratory supervisor
blocks.text: Notify the laboratory supervisor
blocks.zh: 通知實驗室負責人

blocks.en: Severe injuries (deep cuts, severe burns, crush injuries, loss of consciousness):
blocks.text: Severe injuries (deep cuts, severe burns, crush injuries, loss of consciousness):
blocks.zh: 嚴重傷害（深度割傷、嚴重燒燙傷、擠壓傷、失去意識）：

blocks.en: Call emergency services (119 in Taiwan) immediately
blocks.text: Call emergency services (119 in Taiwan) immediately
blocks.zh: 立即撥打緊急電話（臺灣為 119）

blocks.en: Do not move the injured person unless there is immediate danger
blocks.text: Do not move the injured person unless there is immediate danger
blocks.zh: 除非有立即危險，否則不要移動傷者

blocks.en: Provide basic first aid if trained to do so
blocks.text: Provide basic first aid if trained to do so
blocks.zh: 若受過訓練，提供基本急救

blocks.en: Alert the laboratory supervisor and provide information about the incident
blocks.text: Alert the laboratory supervisor and provide information about the incident
blocks.zh: 通知實驗室負責人並說明事件經過

blocks.en: Document the incident thoroughly and follow up with appropriate medical care
blocks.text: Document the incident thoroughly and follow up with appropriate medical care
blocks.zh: 詳實記錄事件，並安排後續醫療照護

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: Biosafety and biosecurity practices at GEMS Taiwan reflect a commitment to responsible science. Through training, proper use of facilities, rigorous risk assessment, clear emergency procedures, and biosecurity measures, we ensure that our research benefits society while minimizing risks to personnel, the environment, and the broader community.
blocks.text: Biosafety and biosecurity practices at GEMS Taiwan reflect a commitment to responsible science. Through training, proper use of facilities, rigorous risk assessment, clear emergency procedures, and biosecurity measures, we ensure that our research benefits society while minimizing risks to personnel, the environment, and the broader community.
blocks.zh: GEMS Taiwan 的生物安全與生物防護做法，體現我們對負責任科學的承諾。透過訓練、設施的正確使用、嚴謹的風險評估、明確的緊急程序與生物防護措施，我們確保研究造福社會，同時把對人員、環境與更大社群的風險降到最低。

Layers of bioreactor safety

attrs.en: Primary containment
Two agar plates side by side. Plate a, spread with lumen-side medium, shows a few bacterial colonies. Plate b, spread with shell-side medium, is clear.
attrs.zh: 並排的兩塊瓊脂培養盤。a 盤塗的是管腔側培養液，可見少數細菌菌落；b 盤塗的是殼側培養液，乾淨無菌落。

attrs.en: The white hollow fiber membrane cartridge mounted upright in the black bioreactor case, linked by clear tubing to a capped glass medium bottle beside it.
attrs.zh: 白色的中空纖維膜匣直立安裝在黑色生物反應器箱體內，以透明管路連到旁邊一瓶加蓋的玻璃培養液瓶。

attrs.en: Secondary containment
Dual use research of concern
A red fire blanket pouch hanging by a lab shelf that holds buffer solutions and acid bottles.
attrs.zh: 掛在實驗室層架旁的紅色防火毯袋，架上放著緩衝液與酸類瓶罐。

attrs.en: Cartons of examination gloves in sizes XS, S, M and L stacked on the floor.
attrs.zh: 堆放在地上的 XS、S、M、L 各尺寸檢驗手套紙箱。

attrs.en: A biosafety cabinet with its sash lowered and a clean, empty work surface.
attrs.zh: 一座生物安全櫃，門已降下，工作檯面乾淨而空曠。

attrs.en: White lab coats and gowns hanging in a row on a wall rack.
attrs.zh: 白色實驗衣與防護袍整排掛在牆架上。

attrs.en: A second biosafety cabinet with a blue frame and a transparent glass sash.
attrs.zh: 第二座生物安全櫃，藍色框架與透明玻璃門。

attrs.en: A wall-mounted emergency eyewash station with a yellow pull-down lever above a sink.
attrs.zh: 壁掛式緊急洗眼器，水槽上方有一支黃色下拉拉桿。

attrs.en: A yellow bag labelled SPC Spill Kit hanging on a white wall.
attrs.zh: 掛在白牆上、標示 SPC Spill Kit 的黃色袋子。

attrs.en: A white first aid box with a red cross, beside a fire extinguisher and reference books.
attrs.zh: 印有紅十字的白色急救箱，旁邊是滅火器與參考書。

attrs.en: Risks and how they are handled

Three posters on the lab door: the GEMS Academy laboratory rules, a Laboratory Area sign listing biological hazard, toxic materials, P1 laboratory and the required PPE of lab coat, gloves, pants and closed-toe shoes, and a chart of the GHS hazard pictograms. The emergency contact table is blurred.
attrs.zh: 實驗室門上的三張海報：GEMS Academy 實驗室規則；一張「實驗區域」標示，列出生物危害、毒性物質、P1 實驗室，以及必備的實驗衣、手套、長褲與包覆式鞋；還有一張 GHS 危害圖示表。緊急聯絡表已做模糊處理。

attrs.en: Open boxes of examination gloves in sizes XS and S on a bench.
attrs.zh: 檯面上打開的 XS 與 S 尺寸檢驗手套盒。

attrs.en: A benchtop autoclave with a round stainless steel lid and a control panel.
attrs.zh: 檯面型高壓滅菌器，圓形不鏽鋼蓋與控制面板。
